title: Cargo ship Khoryv sinks off Romania after drone strike, one dead and three missing
excerpt: The Comoros-flagged general cargo vessel went down about 13 nautical miles off Constanța on 23 October, Romanian authorities said.
x_post: The Comoros-flagged cargo ship Khoryv sank off Constanța, Romania, on 23 October after a drone strike, killing one and leaving three missing, Romanian authorities said. #MaritimeSecurity #Shipping #Seafarers #BlackSea
